steps.label: catalog
command: SELECT jsonb_build_object('version',current_setting('server_version_num'),'encoding',current_setting('server_encoding'),'extensions',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'default_version',default_version,'installed_version',installed_version) ORDER BY name) FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name IN ('pg_trgm','vector','hstore','pg_stat_statements','plpgsql')),'[]'::jsonb),'own_schema_exists',EXISTS(SELECT FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='qa436_local'))::text;

steps.label: core
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa436_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa436_local,public; CREATE TABLE docs(id integer PRIMARY KEY,title text NOT NULL,body text NOT NULL,fts tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS(to_tsvector('english',title || ' ' || body)) STORED); INSERT INTO docs(id,title,body) VALUES(1,'Running foxes','The quick brown fox runs through fields'),(2,'Database backups','PostgreSQL database backup and restore'),(3,'Crème brûlée','李 keeps a Unicode café notebook'),(4,'Slow fox','A slow fox walks'); CREATE INDEX docs_search ON docs USING GIN(fts); CREATE INDEX docs_simple ON docs USING GIN(to_tsvector('simple',body)); SET LOCAL enable_seqscan=off; SELECT jsonb_build_object('english_stems',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM docs WHERE fts @@ plainto_tsquery('english','run fox')),'phrase',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM docs WHERE fts @@ phraseto_tsquery('english','quick brown fox')),'web_or',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM docs WHERE fts @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english','database OR slow')),'negative',(SELECT count(*) FROM docs WHERE fts @@ plainto_tsquery('english','nonexistentquokka')),'unicode',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM docs WHERE to_tsvector('simple',body) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple','李 café')),'indices',(SELECT jsonb_agg(indexname ORDER BY indexname) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='qa436_local'))::text; EXPLAIN(FORMAT JSON,COSTS OFF) SELECT id FROM docs WHERE fts @@ plainto_tsquery('english','run fox'); ROLLBACK;

steps.label: trigram
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa436_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa436_local,public; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm SCHEMA qa436_local; CREATE TABLE words(id integer PRIMARY KEY,label text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO words VALUES(1,'postgres'),(2,'postgras'),(3,'Crème brûlée'),(4,'database backup'),(5,'李'); CREATE INDEX words_trigram ON words USING GIN(label gin_trgm_ops); SET LOCAL enable_seqscan=off; SET LOCAL pg_trgm.similarity_threshold=0.5; SELECT jsonb_build_object('similarity',similarity('postgres','postgras'),'identical_unicode',similarity('Crème brûlée','Crème brûlée'),'matching',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM words WHERE label % 'postgres'),'unicode_pattern',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM words WHERE label ILIKE '%BRûlée%'),'negative',(SELECT count(*) FROM words WHERE label % 'nonexistentquokka'),'distance',('postgres' <-> 'postgras'),'index_names',(SELECT jsonb_agg(indexname ORDER BY indexname) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='qa436_local'))::text; EXPLAIN(FORMAT JSON,COSTS OFF) SELECT id FROM words WHERE label % 'postgres'; ROLLBACK;
